eval_protocol: DemandEnv(seed=999) x 200 rollouts, common to all rows
notes: Served = PPO + expiry ladder + markdown-only/expired invariants in ElasticityEngine.decide. Waste sweep (same protocol): waste-penalty alone (w8) waste 14%; shaping 0.5 waste 4% but margin ~1; w16+shaping0.1 raw waste 5% revenue 29.11; served hybrid waste 3%.
audit_corrections: Earlier table compared SERVED PPO+ladder vs RAW DQN (waste 14%): apples-to-oranges. Served DQN (same ladder/invariants) wastes 4%. PPO still leads served policies on revenue/margin, waste tied at floor.

Zero live waste is accounting-correct for this catalog (sold+wasted+left=817 across 5 seeds; forced-hold wastes 17.2%), but the live simulator's per-SKU independent demand and discount elasticity (lam ~ 2.2 + 9*rel, +40% under 24h) make clearing far easier than real retail; prices also compound -10%/tick to the cost floor inside 24h (21% of env steps at floor). Treat live 0-waste as a simulator artifact until validated on real POS demand.
DemandEnv episodes draw stock-feasible expiries (hours ~ stock x 0.8-2.5), so doomed short-dated overstock is underrepresented.
